objectives.description: Falsifier check: spot-read 2-3 drifted files for sane prose
Confirm baier_katoen uniform-placeholder finding, record per-part spread
Apply bulk token_count rewrite to regenerated worklist

deviations.description: Apply the bulk token_count rewrite to every entry on the regenerated worklist
deviations.reason: The regenerated 84-entry worklist plus the full 12-entry baier_katoen set (union, 88 target ids) was applied via phase3_mutate.py. Post-mutation re-scan still found 8 residual stored-0 entries. Root cause: the corpus has 8 duplicate-id entries (id appears twice in the entries list) -- for each of the 8, one instance is a stale placeholder carrying provenance='migrated from ingest schema (doc_id/source_path/chunks_dir)', token_count=0, empty summary, thinner metadata, and the other instance (same id, same path) is the already-correct, fully-populated v2 entry. The id-keyed by_id dict used for the main mutation pass silently resolves duplicate keys to the last entry, so the stale duplicate is invisible to a by-id lookup. phase3_dup_fix.py iterates the raw entries LIST (not a by-id dict) to find and correct all 8 stale duplicates' token_count from disk, closing the SCOPE 3 defect-class-empty gate honestly. The underlying duplicate-id structural defect (two records per document) is NOT one of the plan's SCOPE 1-8 and is NOT resolved here -- it is recorded for a follow-up task at Phase 7 closeout.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — regenerated worklist mutation supplemented by phase3_dup_fix.py to close 8 duplicate-id stale-placeholder entries invisible to id-keyed lookup; duplicate-id defect itself deferred to a new Phase 7 follow-up task)*
